tok 1.0 "Meeting schedule"

pool authority "Town Planning Authority"
  lane coord "Coordination Unit"
    start nov "November"
    task draft "Draft the schedule of meetings"
    task add "Add draft dates to all calendars"
    task recheck "Recheck all dates"
    task conflicts "Look for potential conflicts"
    task send "Send the final schedule by email"
    task collect "Receive conflicts from Committee Members"
    end done "Schedule finalised"

    task checkd "Check the dates"
    task suggest "Suggest modifications"
  lane members "Committee Members"
    task diary "Check diaries"
    task advise "Advise the Coordination Unit of conflicts"

flow nov -> draft -> add -> checkd -> suggest -> recheck -> conflicts -> send -> diary -> advise -> collect -> done
